etymology.historical_story: Barrett has a history in England and Ireland associated with Norman settlement. One scholarly explanation connects it with Old French barat, through a nickname referring to contention or troublesome behaviour. This remains a proposed surname origin, not a Malay lexical meaning, and does not identify the referent of the supplied lowercase token. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/barrett?geo-lang=en)
